profile.headline: Software Developer at ISG
profile.summary:
Software developer with experience in e-commerce, enterprise and high-performance web technologies. Skilled in all phases of the software development lifecycle. Expert in translating business requirements into technical solutions; and fanatical about quality, usability, security and scalability.

Skills
•	Be able to design, develop, deploy and support RESTful services.
•	Knowledge of the full software development life cycle.
•	Good expertise in Object-oriented, Python, PHP, Java, Javascript, JQuery, CSS, JSON, XML, HTML.
•	Ability to work as part of team with excellent communication& interpersonal skills.
•	Exceptional knowledge of PostgreSQL (or MySQL), SQL and NoSQL.
•	Ability to analyze existing code base and find best solutions for problems.
•	11 years of experience with GNU / Linux.

positions.title: Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description: Skills: Genesys · Linux · MySQL · PHP · Web Services API · Node.js · Laravel · AWS Lambda · Software Development · Python · Microsoft SQL Server · MongoDB · Amazon Dynamodb · AWS Services · TeamCity

positions.title: Sr Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Interfaced with backend data systems to produce dynamic reports and impactful dashboards to help identify key metrics and transform raw data into meaningful, actionable information.
•	Developed and lead app integration with REST / SOAP and other APIs for Google Maps, social media logins, payment processors, and other services.
•	Use Digital Marketing tools such as Google Ads, AdRoll, Simplify and Social Media Marketing to create and configure campaigns.
•	Design custom, professional apps and dashboards using HTML5, CSS3, PHP7+, Bootstrap, etc.
•	Maximize applications’ efficiency, data quality, scope, operability, and flexibility.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · MySQL · PHP · Web Services API · Node.js · Laravel · AWS Lambda · Software Development · Python · Laravel 5.2

positions.title: Software Developer and IT Specialist
positions.description:
•	Maintain and administer computer networks and related computing environments including computer hardware, systems software, applications software, and all configurations. 
•	Perform data backups and disaster recovery operations. 
•	Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, or other network and system problems, and replace defective components when necessary. 
•	Developing secure web applications for data collection and reporting purposes for large-scale performance and quality measurement efforts. 
•	3rd-party API integration via REST-full web services.
•	Perform Agile testing – create and execute test scripts.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · MySQL · PHP · Web Services API · PostgreSQL · Software Development · Python · odoo 9 · MongoDB

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developing mobile applications with NativeScript, XML, Javascript and CSS
• Website development with Wordpress and WooCommerce
• Web development applications with Laravel 5.x Framework, Eloquent ORM, Blade, Php, CSS, HTML, Javascript, JQuery, MongoDB, Postgresql, Mysql, PhpStorm, Git, 0doo 9 and Odoo 10
• Implementation of payment gateways like Paypal and Stripe
• Wordpress's plugins development
• Systems integration
• Project management with Basecamp
• API development with security token authentication methods
* Designed, implemented and managed a cloud infrastructure using Amazon AWS services.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · MySQL · PHP · Laravel · PostgreSQL · Software Development · Python · Laravel 5.2 · NativeScrip · odoo 9

positions.title: DevOps
positions.description:
•	Participated in the analysis, design, implementation, deployment, configuration and maintenance of several Web applications using Java, PHP and Python language.
•	Interfaced with business users to prepare Business Process Requirements (BPR) and Software System Requirements (SSR).
•	Developed OpenERP application technologies with free Linux operating system.
•	Elaborated, executed, and managed designs test cases.
•	Database administration (MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server).
•	Maintained Web Content Management and Design (CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery).
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · MySQL · PostgreSQL · Software Development · Python · odoo 9 · MongoDB
